name: Niigata Comic Market (Gataket)
blurb: The largest doujinshi (self-published comics) market on Japan's west coast, held several times a year at the Niigata City Industrial Promotion Center since 1983.

editions.evidence: Official event page (gataket.com/event/g186/): '2026.12.6（日） 10:30～15:30' at 新潟市産業振興センダー (Niigata City Industrial Promotion Center)

notes: Gataket runs several times a year at the Niigata City Industrial Promotion Center; Gataket 185 already concluded in late September 2026, before this research window, so only Gataket 186 (Dec 6, 2026) is listed. Gataket 186 runs alongside a separate sister event, 'Niigata COMITIA 63', at the same venue/date, but that is a distinct convention/brand run by a different organizer and is not folded into this entry. This is a doujin circle sales event with no celebrity-guest program, so guests is 'none'.
